aggregateIdentityRule: exactly one of aggregateId or localAggregateReference
identifierPolicy: authority and server identities are UUIDs; stable local references use bounded safe identifiers

payload.shape: exact command-specific allowlist for all eight registered command types
payload.canonicalization: recursive key order plus NFC strings plus finite numbers

orderCreate.items: non-empty, bounded, stable UUID catalog identities, positive safe-integer quantities, unique and canonically sorted
orderCreate.money: canonical non-negative decimal strings with exactly two fractional digits
orderCreate.totals: line totals, subtotal, discount, tax and total must reconcile exactly in minor units
orderCreate.frontier: normalized inventory item set must match the reference exactly
orderCreate.payment: attestation command, order identity, method, amount and currency must match the normalized payload

rejections: empty, ambiguous, duplicate or monetarily inconsistent order
irrelevant payment attestation or inventory frontier
tenant branch actor or device ambiguity
